intro: Five dairy-free, egg-free weeknight dinners built around this week's Publix Buy 1 Get 1 FREE items, so you pay for one and get a second one free. Boneless skinless chicken breast is BOGO this week, so buy two packs and use them for two dinners. Italian sausage, ham steak, pulled pork, pasta, sauce, rice, olive oil, broth, green beans and Campari tomatoes are also BOGO. BOGO items that usually contain dairy or egg (cheeses, Rosina meatballs, pesto, Alfredo sauce, King's Hawaiian buns, mayo) were left out.

recipes.title: Greek Sheet-Pan Chicken with Green Beans & Tomatoes
recipes.blurb: Chicken breast, snipped green beans and Campari tomatoes roasted on one pan with Greek seasoning and plenty of olive oil. The tomatoes burst and make their own sauce.

saleIngredients.item: Pero Family Farms Snipped Green Beans
Ben's Original Long Grain White Rice

steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Start the rice on the stove according to the package.
Pound the chicken breasts to an even 3/4 inch (or halve them horizontally). Rub with olive oil, 1 1/2 tsp Greek seasoning, and the zest of the lemon.
Toss green beans, whole Campari tomatoes, and sliced garlic with olive oil and a pinch of salt on a sheet pan. Nestle the chicken on top.
Roast 20–25 min, until the chicken reaches 165°F and the tomatoes are blistered.
Squeeze lemon over everything. Serve over rice and spoon the pan juices on top.
recipes.note: Buy two packs of chicken. Put the second pack in the fridge for the tacos below, or freeze it.

recipes.title: Chicken Tacos with Refried Beans & Salsa
recipes.blurb: Uses the free pack of chicken: seared, spiced and shredded into crunchy taco shells, served with refried beans and salsa.
steps: Season the chicken with 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, and salt.
Sear in an oiled skillet over medium-high, 6 min per side, until 165°F. Rest 5 min, then shred with two forks and toss with the lime juice and a spoonful of salsa.
Warm the refried beans in a small pot with a splash of water. Warm the taco shells in the oven per the box.
Dice the baby cucumbers for a cool, crunchy topping.
Build the tacos: a smear of beans, then chicken, lettuce, cucumber, and salsa.
recipes.note: Rosarita Traditional refried beans may contain lard but have no dairy. The Vegetarian variety is also dairy-free. Old El Paso shells are normally dairy- and egg-free, but check the label on flavored varieties.

recipes.title: Italian Sausage Pasta with Marinara
recipes.blurb: Browned Italian sausage simmered in jarred marinara and tossed with dry pasta. A pantry dinner where the protein, pasta, sauce and oil are all BOGO.
steps: Boil a big pot of salted water for the pasta (penne or rigatoni work well).
Remove the sausage from its casings and brown it in a little olive oil in a deep skillet, breaking it up, about 6 min. Add the diced onion and garlic and cook 3 min more.
Add a jar of marinara, a handful of halved Campari tomatoes, a pinch of pepper flakes, and the basil. Simmer 10 min.
Cook the pasta 1 min shy of al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the pasta into the sauce, loosening it with the pasta water. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil. No cheese is needed.
recipes.note: Choose a Classico flavor with no cheese, like Marinara with Plum Tomatoes or Tomato & Basil. Skip the Four Cheese, Alfredo and Vodka varieties. Mueller's dry pasta is egg-free, but avoid any egg noodles. Carando sausage is usually dairy-free, but check the label because some Italian sausages include cheese.

recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Quick Cucumber Pickles
recipes.blurb: Curly's pre-cooked pulled pork warmed with extra BBQ sauce and piled onto buns with homemade quick pickles. Dinner in 15 minutes.
steps: Quick pickles: thinly slice the baby cucumbers and red onion. Stir the vinegar, sugar, salt, and 1/4 cup water until dissolved, then pour over the vegetables. Let sit while you do the rest.
Heat the pulled pork in a saucepan (or the microwave) with a few extra spoonfuls of Kinder's BBQ sauce.
Toast the buns if you like.
Pile the pork onto the buns and top with the drained quick pickles or Mt. Olive pickle chips. Serve with plain Lay's chips on the side.
recipes.note: The Wonder BOGO includes buns, but many packaged buns contain milk or egg, so check the label. Kinder's has a creamy ranch-style sauce, so pick a straight BBQ flavor instead. Plain Lay's Classic chips are dairy-free, but flavored ones (sour cream, cheddar) are not. Check the Curly's label for your flavor.

recipes.title: Smoky Ham, Rice & Green Bean Skillet
recipes.blurb: A one-skillet Southern-style dinner: seared ham steak, rice cooked in broth, and green beans, with a few dashes of Frank's RedHot.

saleIngredients.item: Ben's Original Long Grain White Rice
Pero Family Farms Snipped Green Beans

steps: Dice the ham steak into 1/2-inch cubes. Brown in olive oil in a large lidded skillet over medium-high, 5 min. Remove.
Add the diced onion and cook 4 min, then the garlic, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and 1/2 tsp thyme for 30 sec.
Stir in 1 cup rice to toast for 1 min, then add 2 cups Swanson broth. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low for 12 min.
Scatter the green beans and ham over the rice, cover again, and cook 6–8 min more until the rice is tender and the beans are crisp-tender.
Fluff, season, and shake Frank's RedHot over the top to taste.
recipes.note: The second ham steak and the extra broth, rice and green beans from the BOGOs can make this a second time later in the week, or go into a quick fried rice. Standard ham steak and Swanson broth are dairy-free, but check the label on flavored or glazed hams.
